complete_examples.text: See for instance, Xu and Zhai [3,4] complied a vehicle–slab track coupled model, through which new methodologies were developed to ascertain the limits of track irregularities and randomly analyse the vibrations of vehicle–track systems.
This paper presents a 3D nonlinear vehicle–slab track coupled model by combining FEM and wheel–rail coupled mechanism.
